privacyRule: No client name, address, parcel identifier, road name, private correspondence, or private source file is published. Client geometry is published only with Dan's approval; the 2023 client maps are described, not shown.

items.authorshipEvidence: Dan sent this map by email on 2013-11-17 in reply to a request for a parcel map with the area for a claim; the source PDF reports Esri ArcMap 10.1 and a creation date of 2013-11-17.
items.transformation: On 2026-11-07 the owner's name, stand code, three parcel identifiers, four road-name labels and a civic address were removed from the PDF text layer, and the title bar was relabelled. No geometry, colour or other text was changed. Rendered at 300 dpi, cropped to the map frame and scaled to 1440x1098. The same file is published on fakkeldy.ca (dfakkeldy/fakkeldy-site#12).
items.visibleLayerRights: Dan's own ArcMap layout and thinning-area outlines. The background vector layers (forest cover, water, trails, property lines) are not separately credited on the sheet; no aerial imagery or tiled basemap is shown.
items.publicationDecision: Publish the redacted original; Dan approved on 2026-11-08 (dfakkeldy/grok-bots#981).

items.authorshipEvidence: Contemporary sent correspondence identifies the images as captured by the creator on a flight and describes the attached mosaic as a first attempt.
items.transformation: Tightly cropped to a non-identifying forest-and-stream area; removed structures, industrial activity, edges, labels, and location context. On 2026-10-28 the black no-data rows above and below the imaged band were cropped away (1440x500); nothing inside the band was edited.
items.visibleLayerRights: Creator-captured aerial photographs and creator-produced mosaic only.
items.publicationDecision: Publish cropped derivative; retain full mosaic privately.

items.authorshipEvidence: Captured on 2026-10-28 from the public NS Marks The Spot browser map at /apps/nsmarksthespot/map/ (default Cape Breton view, licences shown); the interface is the public MIT-licensed NS Marks The Spot source.
items.transformation: 1440x900 browser capture of the public map with the licence footer shown. No imported or private map content is loaded.
items.visibleLayerRights: NS Marks The Spot interface under the repository MIT licence; NS Marks Atlas basemap with the visible licence footer crediting OpenStreetMap contributors, the Open Government Licence - Nova Scotia, OpenFreeMap and OpenMapTiles.
items.publicationDecision: Publish the public-map capture with its licence footer.
